_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in credentials. NEVER commit the real config.json to git. Add config.json to .gitignore.

meta._help: Generate at developers.facebook.com → Your App → Settings → Advanced → System Users. Required permissions: ads_read, business_management. Long-lived tokens last 60 days; refresh before expiry.

google_ads._help: Developer token from ads.google.com → API Center (24-hour approval). OAuth credentials from Google Cloud Console. Refresh token via OAuth playground using scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords. Login customer ID = your MCC if you have one (no hyphens).

tiktok._help: Generate at ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api → Your App → Auth & Scope. Long-lived token expires after 1 year.

output._comment_paused: Set to true if you want paused ads included in the analysis (useful for fatigue retrospectives, noisy for active diagnosis)
output._comment_min_imp: Ads below this impression count are excluded from fatigue analysis. Lower for low-spend accounts, raise for high-spend.
output._comment_currency: All amounts converted to this currency for the unified report. Match your reporting currency.

alerts._comment: If true, failed platform pulls log errors but the script exits 0. If false (default), any failure exits 1, which surfaces the error to your cron monitoring.

google_ads_write._help: Deliberately separate from the read-only `google_ads` block above, even though the credential shape is the same — `write_access_confirmed` must be flipped to true by hand before ads_campaign_draft.py will attempt any call here, so read-only setup never silently doubles as write authorization. `customer_id` is which account gets written to; get it wrong and you're creating PAUSED campaigns in the wrong account, so double-check it. See marketing-os-infra/lib/ads_connector.py's module docstring before touching this.

meta_write._help: Deliberately separate from the read-only `meta` block above — same reasoning as google_ads_write. The access token here needs the `ads_management` permission (the read-only token above only needs `ads_read`); generating a new token with more scope than you've confirmed you want live is exactly the mistake this separate block exists to prevent.

safety._comment: Hard ceiling ads_connector.py enforces in code on any single draft campaign's daily budget, on top of PAUSED-only. Not about trusting the number in a brief — it's a backstop against a malformed or mistaken brief creating a campaign with an absurd budget, even though it can't spend while paused. Raise it deliberately if a real use case needs a bigger daily budget; don't treat hitting this ceiling as a bug to route around.
